item.meaning: An elected political representative chosen by urban voters to advocate for ward-level civic needs in municipal assemblies.
item.source_context: Chapter 12: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas) (fees112.pdf)

item.definition: The urban local government body governing large metropolitan cities with high populations and major revenue needs.
item.source_context: Chapter 12: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas) (fees112.pdf)

item.title: Ward-Level Urban Administration
item.explanation: Dividing cities into administrative wards enables elected Ward Councillors and appointed Municipal Commissioners to efficiently manage urban services.
item.source_context: Chapter 12: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas) (fees112.pdf)

item.name: Municipal Corporation
item.function: The local self-government institution governing large metropolitan cities, headed politically by a Mayor and administratively by a Municipal Commissioner.
item.source_context: Chapter 12: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas) (fees112.pdf)

item.name: Municipal Council (Nagar Palika)
item.function: The urban local self-government body responsible for managing smaller towns and medium-sized cities.
item.source_context: Chapter 12: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas) (fees112.pdf)

item.system_or_law: Trade Licensing and Property Tax System
item.description: Municipal revenue systems where urban properties and business operations pay local taxes to fund public amenities and sanitation.
item.source_context: Chapter 12: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas) (fees112.pdf)

item.cause: Failure of residents to segregate wet and dry household waste at home
item.effect: Municipal waste collection systems clog, recycling efficiency drops, and foul odors and disease risks increase in urban centers.
item.source_context: Chapter 12: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas) (fees112.pdf)

item.category: The Three Types of Urban Local Bodies
items: 1. Nagar Panchayat: Transitional body governing areas changing from rural to urban.
2. Municipal Council (Nagar Palika): Local body governing smaller towns and medium cities.
3. Municipal Corporation (Nagar Nigam): Local body governing large metropolitan cities.
item.source_context: Chapter 12: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas) (fees112.pdf)

item.description: The responsibility of citizens to participate in civic affairs, vote in elections, follow rules, and protect shared public property.
item.source_context: Chapter 12: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas) (fees112.pdf)
